task: Price variance guardrail for automated purchase orders. Validate vendor price against average in-stock cost before PO generation; halt if it exceeds threshold and suggest internal stock.
checklist: PO creation halts if vendor price > (average stock price + threshold)
Alert is sent to the procurement dashboard for manual review
System suggests using free internal stock instead of ordering
Negative: vendor price within threshold -> PO proceeds normally
Edge: no comparable in-stock item exists -> defined fallback behavior, no crash
Edge: price exactly equals the threshold -> inclusive/exclusive rule is explicit and correct
Currency and rounding are consistent in the comparison
